### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS; a string literal in ObjectTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in validateTranslationReferences))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS; a string literal in ObjectTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in validateTranslationReferences))_
- `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS; a string literal in ObjectTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in validateTranslationReferences))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS; a string literal in ObjectTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in validateTranslationReferences))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS; a string literal in ObjectTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in validateTranslationReferences))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/index.mdx`  _(via submitBehavior (literal, a string literal in FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS; a string literal in ObjectTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in pushFormViewCopy; a string literal in validateTranslationReferences))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **177** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e94bc15068987eccf1d83b871e7771af39a25922` — the merge of head `af93f3475c2bf616499ece18571b07eb73022140` into base `c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e94bc15068987eccf1d83b871e7771af39a25922 && git checkout e94bc15068987eccf1d83b871e7771af39a25922
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900 af93f3475c2bf616499ece18571b07eb73022140 && git checkout -B drift-repro c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900 && git merge --no-ff af93f3475c2bf616499ece18571b07eb73022140

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c48cd2c103a9dfa99313a67a3ec622291d793900` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `af93f3475c2bf616499ece18571b07eb73022140`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts and packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts (the two `_views` readers the key is enforced and scaffolded by, read as one change with it), and the cited code read on the head: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts (`translateFormTitle` L1255-1286, `valueOverridesPackagedBase` L3970-3987, `translateView` L1455-1525), packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (`FormViewSchema.submitBehavior` discriminated union L4771-4850, the thank-you member's aliases L4794), packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts L350-358 (`GET /api/v1/forms/SLUG` runs `translateMetadataDocument('view', …)` and serves `view.config` as `form`), ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx L2576-2578 and L2955-2959 (reads `loaded.form.submitBehavior`, draws `title` / `message` for `thank-you`), packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts (`ObjectTranslationDataSchema._views` entry L297-390, the existing `title` and `emptyState` nests).

Inputs: card #28004 body and its three comments (claim 6526132447, file-surface amendment 6526224326, os-dev-report 6527607403); PR #28195 body, 12-file list and the diff against `main` (+598/-39); the check-runs on `af93f347` (read 2026-10-30T16:54Z): 50 names, all `completed`, 39 `success`, 11 `skipped`, 0 `failure`; among the successes Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Lint & Repo Gates (which runs the one locally NOT-MEASURED gate, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`), Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, the three scoped lints, Type Check · workspace/source/consumer/debt ledger, Test Core 1/8-8/8, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate. Author `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no login note is owed. The reviewer is not the drafter (`session_01L9qibxqJVde7kDCjJSHEUo`).

### ① Derived judgments

1. `translation.zod.ts`: the strict `_views.<view>` entry of `ObjectTranslationDataSchema` gains one optional nested key `submitBehavior: { title?, message? }`, itself a `strictObject` whose aliases (`heading`→`title`, `text`/`body`/`description`→`message`) mirror the thank-you member's own (`view.zod.ts` L4794, verified identical), with `guidance` prescriptions for `url` and `kind` (not display copy) and a `thankYou`→`submitBehavior` rename on the view node. The accept set of a translation bundle widens by exactly these two strings under every `_views` entry; everything else under the entry stays refused as before. **Right**, and the nesting is the file's own convention for a second heading on one node (`emptyState.title`), so the panel heading never aliases the form's `title`. Pinned by the schema-face cases in `i18n-resolver.form-thank-you.test.ts` (`url` refused `unrecognized_keys` at the panel path, `kind` refused with the prescription) and the regenerated `translation.mdx`; `gen:strictness-ledger` counts one more strict object (`docs/audits/…/system.md`).
2. `i18n-resolver.ts`: `translateView` now also overlays `config.submitBehavior` through `translateFormSubmitBehavior`, on the same `_views` node and `viewTranslationKey` the form `title` uses, with the same four rules as `translateFormTitle` (L1255-1286, read): only `kind: 'thank-you'`; only an authored non-empty string; ADR-0029 D9.2a override per string through the one `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, where a packaged view with no `submitBehavior` (`packaged = {}`) makes every served string an override and so keeps it, exactly as a packaged view with no `title` does for the title; a missing key keeps the authored string. Identity is preserved when nothing applies, so the `config` copy is made only on a change. **Right.** Pinned by the 11 new resolver cases (named and default form, locale chain, missing key, no invented `message`, `redirect` untouched with the same reference, keys do not cross, override vs catalog, no mutation).
3. The public door really carries it: `form-routes.ts` L350-358 runs `translateMetadataDocument('view', match.view, bundle, { …, packagedBase })` inside `GET /api/v1/forms/SLUG` and serves `view.config` as the response `form`; `FormPage.tsx` L2576-2578 reads `loaded.form.submitBehavior` and L2955-2959 draws `title` / `message` for the `thank-you` kind. So the translated panel reaches an anonymous visitor with no `ui/**` change. **Right**, as the card asserted.
4. Lint `validate-translation-references.ts`: `FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS = {title, submitBehavior}`; a `submitBehavior` key over a list view is an orphan with its own message, and the default form's key is legal for those two tails only (was `title` alone). **Right**, the same shape the `title` tail already had; pinned by the three new lint cases.
5. Extractor `i18n-extract.ts`: `pushFormViewCopy` emits `_views.<key>.title` and `.submitBehavior.title` / `.message` for container forms and `viewKind: 'form'` items under the same runtime key; a non-thank-you kind records both unauthored (`pushOptional`), as an untitled form records `title`. **Right**; the showcase's two authored panels gain their four zh-CN strings so `check:i18n-coverage` stays at `none new` (in the seat's amendment).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28004-form-thank-you-translation.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **minor** (new optional translation key + overlay), `@objectstack/cli` **minor** (`os i18n extract` scaffolds two new keys; coverage counts them), `@objectstack/lint` **minor** (a new accepted key and a new orphan message). Nothing is removed or tightened: a bundle without the key, and a form of another kind, behave byte-identically. `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added` sit line-initial on the PR body and the changeset. **Consistent.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared.
- Files outside the order's first list (`i18n-extract.ts`, `validate-translation-references.ts`, the showcase translations): all three are in the seat's amendment 6526224326; answered in ①.4-5.
- `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` (`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` `_views.{view_name}` row): the seat's follow-up; kept off this PR to stay off governed paths. Accepted.
- ui half: on the read in ①.3 the console already draws the served panel, so the reserved `domain:ui` card is verification-only; the seat decides. Agreed with the reading.
- `ObjectFormPropsSchema.submitBehavior` on a page component is the same thank-you block and is not translated by this PR (noted, not filed): see S1.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no login note.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` against the card (#28004: declare the thank-you `title` / `message` on the `_views` entry and overlay them in `translateView`, with the lint/coverage that reads `_views`; no ui change) and their first consumer:

- **The key holds against its consumer.** The served form item's `config.submitBehavior` is the thank-you member `{ kind, title?, message? }` (`view.zod.ts` L4790-4799); the resolver overlays the two optional strings and leaves `kind` alone; `FormPage` draws exactly those two. Nested under `submitBehavior` the address mirrors the authored path, so an author who knows the form shape knows the key, and the alias table means the everyday spellings (`thankYou`, `heading`, `text`) are renamed rather than refused. Right.
- **Same rules as the form title, by construction.** `translateFormSubmitBehavior` reuses `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, `localeChain`, `pickData` and `viewTranslationKey`; there is no second copy of the override comparison (the resolver's own ⛔ on that). The `{}` edge (packaged view without a panel) is the same conservative edge the title takes. Right.
- **No invented copy.** A panel that authors no `message` gains none, so the console's default wording stays in charge; a translation cannot add a string the form did not author. This is the correct boundary between catalog and authoring. Right.
- **Flat keys not taken.** `thankYouTitle` / `thankYouMessage` on the view node would sit beside the form `title`, the two-strings-one-node confusion the `title` key was built to avoid. Right.
- **Strictness holds.** The entry and the nested panel stay `strictObject`; `url` / `kind` carry prescriptions instead of silent acceptance.
- **Nothing is retroactive.** Existing bundles carry no `submitBehavior`; existing forms are served byte-identically.

Should-fix (none blocks the contract):
- **S1** `ObjectFormPropsSchema.submitBehavior` (`component.zod.ts`, the page `object-form` block; the showcase `new-project-wizard` uses one) is the same thank-you block with no translation key either. The seat should file it as its own card (page component i18n), citing this record, so the gap does not stay "noted, not filed".
- **S2** The `_views` docblock list in `translation.zod.ts` (L297-305) and the extractor's header comment were updated; `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` is the one remaining place that lists the tails without the panel, which the owed follow-up covers. Land it with, not after, the next i18n skill edit.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-dlxqz6`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 表单视图提交后的感谢页（`submitBehavior` 为 `thank-you` 时的 `title` / `message`）有了翻译键 `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.submitBehavior.title` / `.message`，`translateView` 把它套到下发的表单上；`os i18n extract` 会生成这两个键，lint 也认识它们。
- **为什么改：** 公开表单换语言打开时标题和字段都翻了，提交后的感谢页却还是原文，没有键可翻。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加可选翻译键，已有翻译包和其他三种提交行为不变；租户改过的文案照旧优先；作者没写的文案不会被翻译凭空加出来。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（`translateFormSubmitBehavior`）、`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`（`_views.submitBehavior`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.form-thank-you.test.ts`，预期 11 条全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，契约复审已 PASS，由席位落地。控制台已经直接画服务端下发的感谢页，不需要 ui 跟进卡。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。
